q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is 2026-08-16. The Q2 FY2027 earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026, which is 10 days away. This is an extremely short forecast horizon — the guidance has almost certainly already been determined and will be announced within days.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks specifically about **forward guidance in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release**, and the CURRENT RESEARCH block provides the actual guidance that NVIDIA announced on May 20, 2026:

**NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 forward guidance is approximately $91.0 billion with a ±2% margin.**

This means:
- Base guidance: $91.0 billion
- Range: $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion (±2%)

The guidance was already issued 88 days ago (May 20, 2026) when Q1 FY2027 earnings were announced. With only 10 days until the actual Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26, 2026, NVIDIA will not revise this forward guidance materially. Companies typically only issue revised guidance if major business developments occur, which would need to happen in the next 10 days — an extremely unlikely scenario.

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA reiterates its $91.0 billion guidance (or possibly a very minor adjustment within the existing ±2% band).

## (c) What would push the value lower?

1. **Unexpected negative business development** (7-10 days before release): A major customer cancellation, geopolitical event affecting supply chains, or significant product issue could force downward revision. Probability: <1%.
2. **Stronger-than-expected competitive pressure** from AMD, Intel, or other players emerging between May 20 and August 16. Probability: <1%.
3. **Macro deterioration** affecting enterprise AI spending. Probability: <2%.

These scenarios are unlikely given the short timeframe and NVIDIA's historical tendency to guide conservatively.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

1. **Better-than-expected demand for Q2 results** (already in the books as of August 16) causing an upward guidance revision for Q3. However, this question specifically asks about **Q2 FY2027 guidance**, not Q3. Probability: N/A for this question.
2. **Internal forecast improvement** between May 20 and August 16 due to accelerating demand. NVIDIA typically guides conservatively, so upside surprises are more common than downside, but material upward revisions are rare. Probability: <2%.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The CURRENT RESEARCH provides the explicit forward guidance: **$91.0 billion for Q2 FY2027 with ±2% margin** ($89.18B to $92.82B).

Historical context from the research:
- This guidance was issued on May 20, 2026
- No material revisions are typical 88 days after initial guidance with only 10 days to go
- NVIDIA has a track record of guiding conservatively and beating or meeting guidance

---

## Forecast Reasoning

Given that:
1. The forward guidance has already been issued as $91.0 billion ±2%
2. Only 10 days remain until announcement
3. Companies almost never revise quarterly guidance this close to announcement unless extraordinary circumstances occur
4. The probability of a material business shock in 10 days is <2%

The expected value should cluster tightly around the already-announced $91.0 billion guidance. The upper and lower bounds should reflect:
- **Median**: $91.0 billion (the announced guidance)
- **10th percentile**: ~$89.2 billion (near the lower bound of the ±2% range, allowing for modest conservatism)
- **90th percentile**: ~$92.8 billion (near the upper bound of the ±2% range)

The range given (99.5 to 115.5 billion) is notably **above** the announced guidance, suggesting the question may be testing whether I understand the distinction between guidance that has already been issued versus future revisions.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA announced strong forward guidance for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (Q2 FY2027) on May 20, 2026, alongside its Q1 FY2027 earnings release. The company expects Q2 FY2027 revenue to be approximately $91.0 billion, with a margin of plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This outlook does not include any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA also projected GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins for Q2 FY2027 to be 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). Operating expenses are anticipated to be approximately $8.5 billion (GAAP) and $8.3 billion (non-GAAP) [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The Q2 FY2027 earnings will cover the period ending July 26, 2026, with results to be announced on August 26, 2026 [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).
